title: CEG Converge 2026
location: Computer History Museum, Mountain View, CA
description: First-ever North America Conference of CEG alumni! Join us on Sept 26, 2026 at the Computer History Museum in Mountain View, CA to reconnect with classmates, hear inspiring talks, network, and grow together.

title: Panel Discussion: Breaking into Project Management
description: Join us for a live career session with two professionals sharing experiences, insights, and practical advice on navigating the path into Project Management as a graduate student.

additional_metadata.full_description:
Breaking into Project Management as a graduate student can feel confusing especially when most PM roles ask for experience.

So, what actually works?

Join us for a live career session with two professionals who can share their experiences, insights, and practical advice on navigating the path into Project Management.

If you’re a graduate student aspiring to break into Project Management, this is a session you don’t want to miss.

Come with your questions. Leave with a clearer roadmap.

title: CEG Echo: Lake 22 Hike (near Seattle)
description: Family-friendly hike for CEG alumni! Reconnect and share stories. Bring hiking boots, extra shoes, plenty of water, and snacks. - Murali (1992 CSE)
